description: This file defines a class AzureBlobService which serves as a wrapper for Azure Blob storage interactions. It includes method signatures for downloading, uploading, and checking the existence of blobs, but the implementations are pending.

classes.name: AzureBlobService
classes.description: A wrapper class for interacting with Azure Blob Storage. Currently contains method signatures with placeholders to be implemented.
